unstated_details: Part 1 cells are rung-level: one row per (game, player, stat, point) of the book's primary arm; gap = mean(hit - P); bootstrap clusters are games and dates drawn once per season (default_rng(2026) / default_rng(2027), B = 5,000) and shared by every cell, bin, stat, arm and book; decision interval = union of the percentile intervals; p = max of the two.
Part 1S cells are pooled over both seasons per (bin, stat); CALIBRATED needs only the pooled cell, OVERCONFIDENT / UNDERCONFIDENT also need the same per-season sign (rule, N5).
A cell failing its minimum-data gate gets 'NO WORD (gate)'. By-stat words are not gated.
The model main line for the distance slice is the half-point line with P closest to 0.5 (ties to the lower line); distance = (main line - L) / u, u = 2 for pts and 1 otherwise.

Arms: primary = no window game, lead <= 66 min, no excluded rung/ladder; S1 = window games included; S2 = no lead cap; S3 = excluded rungs and ladders added back. Each differs from the primary in one respect only.
A fresh default_rng(2026) per plan (arm A, then each bin), seasons ascending, weeks ascending.
Attack (ix) (FanDuel first listing from the raw files) and the quote-age part of (v) beyond null counts are not automated; they are run by hand only if a word is PROFITABLE.
